content:
Hi all, would it be a good idea to allow for informally stated conjectures in some folder in formal-conjectures, before they get formalised? Or is there some repo for submitting informal conjectures, e.g. in MD files?

I think this could be a good way to grow the repo, while also providing a GitHub-based alternative to various lists/benchmarks with open problems.

Please do let me know if this is off-topic. :blush:
Hi, thanks for your interest! the canonical way to add new suggetions for conjectures informally and coordinate is to open an issue on our github repo

Thanks Moritz -- makes sense!

One follow-up: would you be open to also having a folder for informal conjectures -- e.g. an issue template that, once triaged/accepted, gets turned into a short MD doc in an informal_conjectures/? Maybe one could keep issues as the place for discussion, but have the folder serve as a more readable list of open problems?

Or would you rather keep the issue tracker as the single source of truth, to avoid maintaining two places for the same info? Happy to help sketch a template if useful either way.
